authority_source: user explicit authorization of a new named R5 corrective packet in the same preserved task/worktree with a fresh review budget
classification: A fresh bounded correction subpacket for three final R5 post-PM P1s and their P2 proof gap. It completes the existing R5 mapped-action/receipt contract, does not change R6 pairing/session authority, and does not open a new platform or generic transport/broker surface.

instance_receipt_plan.requirement: Extend the signed generation-two post-PM receipt plan for the existing mac.lima.instance entry to exactly Start, Stop, Remove and Restore. Keep Create exclusively as the Stage-1 cross-generation receipt.
instance_receipt_plan.identity: Every ordinary instance action gets a deterministic receipt ID/path joined to scope, exact attempt, entry, action, manifest generation/digest and request digest. lima-stop must resolve its exact signed Stop plan before effect.
instance_receipt_plan.prohibitions: No new role/action pair, generic action string, caller-selected instance, or reuse of the Stage-1 Create receipt.

prepared_cas_recovery.classification: Classify requests before the normal current-counter gate as exactly new, exact prepared retry, exact effect-started retry, exact completed retry, or conflict.
prepared_cas_recovery.prepared_retry: Accept only when request counter + 1 equals current state counter, source anchor is still current, and the retained signed prepared record exact-matches request/receipt/entry/action/attempt/manifest/executor. Do not allocate or increment again.
prepared_cas_recovery.effect_journal: Use a durable executor-owned per-attempt effect journal under the existing fixed lifecycle state root, absent-or-exact and no-follow, with Prepared, EffectStarted, EffectObserved and Completed states joined to request/prepared hashes. Persist EffectStarted before spawn and EffectObserved before receipt publication.
prepared_cas_recovery.resume: Prepared with no effect journal may mark/start once. EffectStarted must first perform the exact action-specific read-only observation: exact intended after-state completes without replay; exact before-state may resume only through the same idempotent closed primitive and attempt journal; any partial/ambiguous/mismatched state preserves and blocks. Completed returns only the exact durable receipt. CAS/retry paths must never strand a known no-effect prepared record or repeat an observed effect.

non_circular_guest_effects.decision: R5 must not depend on an already-installed guest r5-post-pm executor. Remove every R5 invocation of /usr/libexec/substrate/substrate-lifecycle-linux r5-post-pm. Do not edit src/bin/substrate-lifecycle-linux.rs; that file remains R6-owned.
non_circular_guest_effects.host_executor: The fixed macOS privileged executor performs each existing closed R5 guest transition using only measured limactl plus an exhaustive role/action-specific table of fixed guest executables and literal argv. This is executor-owned lifecycle control, not caller-visible session or pairing authority.
non_circular_guest_effects.artifact_projection: For staged workspace, publisher-executor, guest binaries, units and other byte objects, source bytes must come only from the no-follow manifest/build-evidence-bound installed or staged artifact identity. Use fixed limactl copy to an executor-owned attempt-scoped guest temporary path followed by fixed install/chown/chmod/fsync/digest/rename commands and strict re-observation. No repository, CWD, environment, caller path or payload.
non_circular_guest_effects.non_byte_effects: Directories, group, membership, private home, sentinel, known-hosts and service/socket states use only fixed system executables/argv derived from the validated manifest role and PM. Known-hosts remains descriptor/no-follow on the host.
non_circular_guest_effects.publisher_executor_role: Installing and attesting the fixed guest publisher-executor artifact is an ordinary R5 projected artifact action for later use; it is not a prerequisite for executing R5 itself. Its exact digest/owner/mode/path must be observed before its receipt completes.
non_circular_guest_effects.prohibitions: No generic guest executor, arbitrary shell string, raw helper, caller command, new endpoint/transport, pairing session, or Linux-host behavior.

proof.pure_helpers: Factor receipt-plan lookup, request-state classification, effect-command planning, artifact source/target joins and retry decisions into deterministic pure helpers testable on macOS without native mutation.
required: unit tests prove all four ordinary instance receipt plans and reject Create/unlisted actions
unit tests prove new/prepared/effect-started/completed/conflict counter and CAS classifications plus every kill boundary
unit tests prove exhaustive role/action command plans, fixed tools/argv, artifact identity joins and no r5-post-pm dependency
tests prove exact after-state completion, exact before-state safe resume, and ambiguous preservation
existing shell/control/XPC/installer tests and MAC native plus x86_64-apple-darwin checks remain green

review.sequence: after mandatory-input remediation, one fresh discovery review or same-subject three-lens burst, remediation of valid P1/P2, then one different fresh closure review
review.supplemental_rule: only P1/P2 directly caused or unmasked by immediately preceding remediation under unchanged authority/risk
review.reviewers: fresh read-only gpt-5.6-terra Extra High; closure different from discovery
review.terminal: CLEAN permits publication; exhausted budget with P1/P2 blocks

hard_exclusions: editing or repurposing the immutable prior R5 review record/artifacts
src/bin/substrate-lifecycle-linux.rs or any ordinary Linux-host/Windows behavior
new role/action pair, generic effect broker/helper/selector, endpoint, transport, forwarding, pairing or TTY/session behavior
native install, code signing, Keychain/XPC/Lima mutation or official evidence action
reset, clean, rebase, archive, donor-copy or publication before terminal CLEAN
publication: On terminal CLEAN, publish the complete accumulated R5 subject plus immutable prior review artifacts and new correction review artifacts as exactly one normal fast-forward commit from the expected base, return increment AUX-R3-MAC-EVIDENCE-RECOVERY-R5 with packet_id correction and next_increment R6.
